sunoData.title: Empty Chapel Drift
sunoData.tags: Ambient game music with a slow pulse and suspended tones, built for abandoned spaces and uncanny stillness; verse-like sections evolve from distant drone and soft metallic resonance into a pre-drop layer of reversed swells, brittle ticks, and low sub pressure, then a wider middle section adds bowed textures, ghostly bell fragments, and faint sidechain breathing before the final passage thins back to hushed air and a lonely tonal shimmer. Sparse evolving pads, subtle granular crackle, and long decay tails create a polished, eerie, intimate-close mix with wide nocturnal depth., ambient
